verdict.rationale: The docs confirm that Justworks has a payroll run initiated from Pay > Make a Payment. They also advise checking payroll data in Analytics > Custom Payroll Report and in employee profiles before running payroll. However, that review happens in a separate report rather than within one end-to-end run flow. Missing for 10: documented hours/earnings review step inside the run, preview of totals before submission, an explicit submit/approve step, a single-flow walkthrough, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
